title: 需求澄清与模型细化
scope: 有限需求/候选及审阅纯转换；新增原文与澄清分离的修订信封和严格后继候选检查。网络与持久化仅由app装配，无语义验收声明。
implemented_scope: Explicit finite interpretation/clarification with immutable answer history; strict raw-source and typed-domain-candidate inspection; source/request-bound finite review sessions, saved instance references, explicit proposal adoption and prior-version isolation. Offline revision-context/0.1 remains available. Execution-revision-envelope/0.1 and revision-context/0.2 separately preserve original source and verified question/action evidence; typed-domain-revision/0.1 inspection validates the new finite syntax and exact evidence. Saved revision proposals pin actual method instructions for stable replay. Bounded real language calls and local persistence are composed by apps; this package has no transport, persistence, automatic semantic acceptance or fidelity proof. Fixed revision-output-schema/0.2 constrains the complete revision generation shape and known expression return categories without replacing local type, scope or evidence checks; execution-revision-envelope/0.2 provides an exact UTF-8 parent projection while preserving historical context replay. Transport compatibility and candidate fidelity require actual validation. Pure checker-feedback observations preserve exact rejected candidate text and recompute existing formal diagnostics without inventing requirements or repairing output. The app binds original plan/receipt/response, permits at most three explicit feedback ancestors with one POST per prepared run, and exports verified complete results for unconfirmed review, including isolated candidate rejection. Original context/history and semantic/adoption boundaries remain unchanged.
